title: Agent Notifier message v1
description: What a sender POSTs to /v1/messages. Field names are camelCase. Unknown top-level fields are rejected so a typo never passes silently; `metadata` is the open extension point. See docs/architecture.md and docs/adr/0003-message-schema.md.

version.description: Schema major version. The hub rejects any other value with 422.

id.description: Sender-chosen idempotency key. A retry with the same id and source returns the stored message instead of creating a second one. The hub assigns a ULID when it is absent.

class.description: Declared class. When present it wins over every rule. When absent, the user's rules decide, then `generic`.

event.description: The sender's own event name, dotted, for rules to match (e.g. `claude-code.notification.idle_prompt`). Never shown to the user.

title.description: One line shown in every channel. Plain text.

summary.description: Plain text shown as the native notification body and in the inbox row. Never sent to the phone in the default minimal payload.

body.description: Markdown shown in the conversation detail and the rich popup. Stays on the hub unless the relay runs in full-payload mode.

actions.description: Buttons, in display order. Phone channels show the first three that make sense remotely (see docs/architecture.md › Phone relay).

awaitsResponse.description: True when the sender will long-poll /v1/messages/{id}/response. Answer buttons (approve, deny, reply, choice) are only offered while a sender waits; without a waiter they are hidden and only open and snooze remain.

correlationKey.description: Dedupe and supersede key within the conversation. A new message with the key of an open message replaces it in place (same notification, updated content) instead of pinging again.

resolves.description: Correlation keys of open messages in the same conversation that this message resolves (e.g. a permission was answered in the terminal).

sensitive.description: True when even the title must not leave the Mac. The phone then gets only the class and the agent name, whatever the relay payload mode.

createdAt.description: When the sender produced the event. The hub records its own receivedAt and orders by that.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the message moves to `expired`, its popup closes and a waiting sender gets status `expired`. Defaults per class (docs/architecture.md › Lifecycle).

metadata.description: Flat sender facts for rules and display (tool name, model, exit code). No secrets: metadata is stored and may be shown.

agent.description: Stable agent id, lowercase (e.g. `claude-code`, `codex`). Rules and per-source settings key on it.

host.description: Machine name, when the sender runs on another machine than the hub.

conversation.description: The agent session the message belongs to. Coalescing, supersede and resolve all work within one conversation.

id.description: The agent's session id (Claude Code `session_id`). Unique per source.agent.

cwd.description: Working directory. Shown as the project name; never sent to the phone.

focusTarget.description: How the `open` action brings the conversation forward. The hub tries `url`, then `terminal`, then activates `bundleId`.

url.description: Deep link that opens the conversation (custom scheme or https). Only schemes on the user's allowlist are opened.

bundleId.description: macOS bundle id of the app hosting the session (e.g. `com.mitchellh.ghostty`, `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`).

id.description: Unique within the message; returned to the sender as `actionId`.

value.description: For `choice`: the value returned to the sender. For `snooze`: minutes, as a string.

destructive.description: Shown in the destructive style and never offered as an ntfy one-tap button.

actionKind.description: approve, deny and choice answer with a fixed value; reply answers with text; open focuses the conversation and answers nothing; snooze hides the message and re-pings later.

actionResponse.description: Body of GET /v1/messages/{id}/response. Not part of the POST body; defined here so senders validate both ends against one file.

status.description: `pending`: the long-poll timed out with no answer, poll again. `answered`: see actionId. `resolved`, `superseded`, `expired`: closed without an answer; the sender falls back to its own prompt.

value.description: The choice value or the reply text.
